notes.title: Fixes on Demo
notes.content:
We fixed a small amount of bugs in the demo:

[list]
[*] fixed an issue with y-button on startscreen that causes a language-change.
[*] fixed waterplane (was broken)
[*] fixed some invisible walls
[*] fixed an issue that the astral-portal despawns when player is too far away
[*] added a cooldown of 2 seconds to mementos. It should prevent instant collecting if player smashes interact button
[*] added a note at the end that both decisions lead to different play times.
[*] added a feature to submit mementos from ingame. This is just a feature test.
[/list]
We will be adding more mementos by players within the next update, this is just a smaller patch after Gamescom release. We are now back and recovered from Covid, more updates on [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/grownarts/paws-and-leaves-a-thracian-tale]Kickstarter [/url]and demo will follow :).

If you like to submit a bug please use: [url=mailto:bug@pawsandleaves.com]bug@pawsandleaves.com[/url] or join our [url=https://discord.com/invite/TmJ9uC2ev3]Discord[/url].

Pro tip: play both path-choices of our demo.
